flexkv_stable_tag_inspected.status: Source inspection only: older SGLang configuration signature and no flexkv.transfer.layerwise module required by SGLang 0.5.20. Not built or benchmarked.

notes: Matched comparison environments share addon versions within each engine; sglang-orbitkv-event uses the original release environment to isolate the notification change.
LMCache uses its standalone MP daemon on both engines; 16 GiB L1, 64-token chunks, LRU.
FlexKV was configured with default SM copies; MPS, SSD, GDS, and optional metrics were disabled. Both current engine adapters failed before requests. No upstream adapter code was patched.
Only complete 45-request runs have latency rows. Failed setup attempts are recorded separately and have no rank.
Five observations per length and phase are exploratory; nondeterministic performance output comparisons are not correctness qualification for external backends.
